result.edit: Replace the sum assignment `assign s=(a|b|ci);` with the correct XOR-based full-adder sum `assign s=(a^b^ci);`. The OR expression incorrectly produced 1 whenever any input was high (e.g., a=1,b=1,ci=0 gave s=1 instead of 0), matching the observed cycle3/5/6 mismatches (got 11, expected 10). Carry logic is unchanged.
